sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Pass-through of the edit function
sections.what: Makes the shared edit function and its edit type available to lessons code under this local path.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps one copy of the edit logic that both the app and the lessons tools use.
sections.watch_out: Changes in the shared package change this behaviour without any edit to this file.

summary: A one-line pass-through that exposes the shared presentation edit function to the lessons tools.
purpose: Let lessons code import the edit function from a local path.
why: Likely reason: the edit logic is shared with another part of the app, so it is kept in one place.
how: Re-exports the function applyPresentationEdits and its TextEdit type from the shared package.
inputs: No inputs of its own. Callers pass a recipe and a list of edits to the shared function.
outputs: The same results as the shared function: an edited copy of the recipe and a change history.
risks: Any change in the shared package changes lessons behaviour without any change in this file. The shared package is not in this packet.
debug: If edits fail with an import error, check that the shared package path resolves. If the results look wrong, look at the shared package, since this file holds no logic.
